summary: This maintenance release makes automatic update checks fully silent and simplifies the main header for a cleaner GTK 4 interface.
changelog: Automatic update checks now run silently in the background without showing a spinner, status panel, or startup overlay.
The main interface is available immediately and is never blocked while the automatic check is in progress.
Optional and mandatory update notices continue to appear only when a newer release requires attention.
The manual Check for updates action in the About window retains visible progress and result feedback.
Removed the descriptive subtitle from the main header.
Centered the single-line application title vertically using the native GTK HeaderBar layout.
Added regression tests for the silent startup flow and simplified header structure.
